subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “Many said they walked more comfortably and waited for buses with less stress.”?
options: Shade seemed simple, but it changed daily movement.
He moved the event to the gym and changed soccer into a simple ball-passing game.
At noon, the playground had almost no shade.
The debate changed how students saw ordinary objects.

optionRationales.reason: 本文可直接核對「Many said they walked more comfortably and waited for buses with less stress. Shade seemed simple, but it changed daily movement.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「He moved the event to the gym and changed soccer into a simple ball-passing game.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「At noon, the playground had almost no shade.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The debate changed how students saw ordinary objects.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Many said they walked more comfortably and waited for buses with less stress. Shade seemed simple, but it changed daily movement.」，答案為「Shade seemed simple, but it changed daily movement.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「Shade seemed simple, but it changed daily movement.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
